license_required.quote: A person may not engage in or work at the business or trade of or hold out to the public that the person is an electrician, electrical contractor, residential electrician, journeyman electrician, or master electrician in this state until the person has received from the department a license or permit to work as an electrical contractor, residential electrician, journeyman electrician, or master electrician.

issuing_authority.quote: the department shall issue the proper license to the applicant

name.quote: "Board" means the state electrical board provided for in 2-15-1764.

type.quote: "Board" means the state electrical board provided for in 2-15-1764.

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industry provided for in Title 2, chapter 15, part 17.

degree_required.value: Graduate electrical engineer of an accredited college or university (master electrician pathway) OR completion of approved apprenticeship program (journeyman pathway)

experience_source.quote: An applicant for a master electrician's license shall furnish written evidence of at least one of the following: (a) being a graduate electrical engineer of an accredited college or university and having a minimum of 2,000 hours of legally obtained practical electrical experience; or (b) having at least 8,000 hours of legally obtained journeyman level experience

duration.value: 2,000–8,000 hours depending on tier and pathway
duration.quote: having at least 8,000 hours of legally obtained journeyman level experience

kind.value: practical electrical experience / journeyman level experience / apprenticeship
kind.quote: completion of an approved apprenticeship program under Title 39, chapter 6, or a substantially equivalent program in the electrical trade

exams.name: Master Electrician Examination
exams.notes: At least 80 questions covering the national electric code and board rules/applicable laws under Title 37.
exams.quote: satisfactorily pass an examination prescribed by the board. The examination must consist of at least 80 questions designed to fairly test the applicant's knowledge and the applicant's technical application skills in the following subjects: (a) the national electric code; and (b) board rules and applicable laws under Title 37.

exams.name: Journeyman Electrician Examination
exams.notes: At least 60 questions covering the national electric code and board rules/applicable laws under Title 37.
exams.quote: The examination for a journeyman's license must consist of at least 60 questions designed to fairly test the applicant's knowledge and the applicant's technical application skills in the following subjects: (a) the national electric code; and (b) board rules and applicable laws under Title 37.

exams.name: Residential Electrician Examination
exams.notes: At least 50 questions covering the national electric code and board rules/applicable laws under Title 37.
exams.quote: The examination for a residential electrician's license must consist of at least 50 questions designed to fairly test the applicant's knowledge and the applicant's technical application skills in the following subjects: (a) the national electric code; and (b) board rules and applicable laws under Title 37.

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice without examination to a person licensed in another state if the board determines that the other state's license standards at the time of application to this state are substantially equivalent to or greater than the standards in this state

requirements.value: Other state's license standards must be substantially equivalent to or greater than Montana's standards, and there must be no reason to deny the license under Montana law. Applicant must affirm that verification from the other state has been requested.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice without examination to a person licensed in another state if the board determines that: (a) the other state's license standards at the time of application to this state are substantially equivalent to or greater than the standards in this state; and (b) there is no reason to deny the license under the laws of this state governing the profession or occupation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in electrical work or holding out as an electrician without a required license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person may not engage in or work at the business or trade of or hold out to the public that the person is an electrician, electrical contractor, residential electrician, journeyman electrician, or master electrician in this state until the person has received from the department a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to display or present an electrician's license at a jobsite when requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An employee of the department may issue a citation to and collect a fine, as provided in 37-68-316, from a person at a jobsite where the person is performing electrical work if the person fails to display an electrician's license at the request of the department employee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the title of licensed electrician, master electrician, journeyman electrician, or residential electrician without being qualified and licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person, firm, partnership, corporation, or association may not assume or use the title or designation of licensed master electrician, master electrician, licensed journeyman electrician, journeyman electrician, licensed residential electrician, residential electrician, licensed electrician, or electrician unless qualified and licensed under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employment agency or labor union referring an unlicensed person to perform electrical contractor, journeyman, or master electrician work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A private or public employment agency or labor union, or an employee of the agency or union who refers persons for employment by others may not refer a person for employment by others to perform the work of an electrical contractor, residential electrician, journeyman electrician, or master electrician in this state unless the person has received from the department a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing false information in a license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the required information, except pursuant to 37-1-138, or the filing of false information is grounds for denial or revocation of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as determined by the board following a hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding of unprofessional conduct by an applicant or license holder, impose a sanction provided by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a cease and desist order issued by the department for practicing without a license or in violation of statute or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department may issue a cease and desist order if the department determines through the receipt of credible evidence that a person is acting, has acted, or is about to act related to a profession or occupation in Title 37: (a) without the license required to practice the profession or occupation
